description: High-level dual-Z gantry move action for two independently controlled Z axes.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board that should receive the Z-axis command.

inputs.label: Left Z Position (cm)
inputs.description: Target left Z position measured from the calibrated origin.

inputs.label: Right Z Position (cm)
inputs.description: Target right Z position measured from the calibrated origin.

inputs.label: Speed Profile
inputs.description: Named speed preset for the future Z motion controller.

advanced_inputs.label: Left Z Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the left Z axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: Left Z Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the left Z axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: Right Z Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the right Z axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: Right Z Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the right Z axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: Limit Switch Layout
advanced_inputs.description: Choose whether the Z gantry uses 2 shared/home switches or 4 independent end-stop switches.

advanced_inputs.label: Left Z Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the left Z minimum/home limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Left Z Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the left Z maximum limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Right Z Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the right Z minimum/home limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Right Z Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the right Z maximum limit switch.

outputs.label: Accepted
outputs.description: Whether the future Z gantry runner accepted the move.

outputs.label: Target
outputs.description: Echo of the requested left/right Z targets in centimeters.
